sec: sec:A003: Limit AI agent data access / Control mays

blocks.id: blk:A003: Limit AI agent data access / Control mays/1
blocks.text: Enabling agent identity management. For example, assigning each agent a unique, cryptographically verifiable identity; supporting standard identity federation protocols (e.g., OAuth 2.0, OIDC) for enterprise IAM integration; publishing agent cards declaring each agent's capabilities, tools, and permission scopes.

sentences.text: For example, assigning each agent a unique, cryptographically verifiable identity; supporting standard identity federation protocols (e.g., OAuth 2.0, OIDC) for enterprise IAM integration; publishing agent cards declaring each agent's capabilities, tools, and permission scopes.

blocks.id: blk:A003: Limit AI agent data access / Control mays/2
blocks.text: Enabling agent access and governance through permission-ready architecture. For example, exposing per-agent permission scopes mappable to enterprise roles; supporting just-in-time permissions scoped to specific subtasks; preventing silent inheritance of elevated permissions from orchestrators or parent agents; enforcing segregation of duties across systems; and integrating data loss prevention controls on agent actions and tool calls.
